title: News mention volume (mentions_24h), independent of sentiment direction, vs real outcome

tables.name: mentions_24h terciles: real vs random-shuffle control

notes: Tests attention/coverage VOLUME as its own signal, independent of whether that coverage is positive or negative -- distinct from every prior stone, which tested sentiment DIRECTION. mentions_24h is the real, uncapped 24h mention count (fixed 2026-07-29 after a bug pinned it at a saturated 40 for every liquid ticker). Stone #4 of 6 in the user's 2026-08-18 'turn over every stone' sentiment review.

conclusion.summary: Correlation 0.041975143264129974. HIGH-mentions tercile beats LOW tercile on both metrics: False. HIGH beats its own random-shuffle control: False. n=160 is a reasonable sample for this project's track-only signals, more than stones 1-3 -- no real signal detected.
